C0805.title: 33 Malicious npm Packages Use Dependency Confusion to Harvest Developer Environment Data
C0805.summary: On May 29, 2026, Microsoft Threat Intelligence disclosed an npm dependency confusion campaign in which a threat actor published malicious packages under several maintainer aliases on May 28 and May 29, impersonating internal corporate namespaces across multiple organization scopes. Once installed, the packages executed an obfuscated reconnaissance payload that collected system information, hostnames, environment variables, and developer context, and the related packages and users were later removed.
